sourceGap.editorialPolicy: Do not synthesize or reconstruct missing F/G entries from modern dictionaries or other editions; recovery requires an independently identified witness and separate provenance layer.

structuralNotes: The left scan edge is cropped. Initial Eſ- is supplied only where the surviving same-witness surface and lexicographic sequence make the headword structurally secure, and each supply is documented explicitly.
Nine false negatives are recorded; five required new structured articles and four were already represented in the selected layer.
`Febrero` retains an unresolved damaged Cahíta glyph group; no secondary witness supplies the reading.
`Feriar vna coſa por otra` preserves `Ná- / culia` unjoined because the short first segment is not expanded conjecturally.
`Filo de cuchillo` preserves `Cuchiriba / hua` as two visible segments because no hyphen is clearly visible at the line break.
The p157→p158 discontinuity remains ALC1737-gap-0001 and is not converted into a normal page continuation.
